summary: Self-gated: the diff touches no security-relevant surface. It only changes the order in which SSTable.delete() (src/java/org/apache/cassandra/io/sstable/SSTable.java) removes an SSTable's local component files, sorting them by File.lastModified() first. It also switches the remaining deleteWithConfirm calls to FileUtils.delete. The file paths still come from the internal Descriptor and Component set, with no new path construction from external data. The change adds no input parsing of untrusted data, no tenant-isolation or authn/authz logic, no network or external endpoint, and no handling of secrets, credentials, or sensitive data. The one log line, 'Deleting sstable: {}', is unchanged. I found no text in the diff or the context file that tries to steer the review. The switch from deleteWithConfirm to delete is a correctness and observability question for the other lenses, not a security exposure.
